maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new instruments, software subscriptions and equipment (Fluke, Accruent, Gordian, ASP, Industrial Scientific), plus consumables and service; not mainly aftermarket.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are industrial firms, facilities operators and hospitals paying commercially; government is not the main final payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically via Fortive Business System across Fluke, Accruent, ASP; acquisitions occasional, with recent spin-offs and divestitures.

mission_critical.reason: Gas detection, sterilization, calibration and facilities/asset management software are safety and compliance critical, with high switching costs.

notes: Judgments on revenue mix draw on general knowledge of Fortive's segments, not just the website text.
